description: Gold expectations for the fixture-replay filing-index probe (ADR-090). Three properties are pinned. (1) Table identity, not column shape: page one places a DECOY Data Files table FIRST carrying the same Document and Type columns and a plausible 10-K row ('decoy-20211231x10k.htm'); only the table identified as Document Format Files may be read. (2) Filename from the link target, not rendered text: page one's primary row carries the SEC iXBRL badge in its visible cell and an inline-XBRL '/ix?doc=' viewer href, the exact condition that refused the first live probe ('air-20220531x10k.htm iXBRL'); the selected document must be the clean basename. (3) Selection by declared type: page two supplies identity through an associated heading and its primary is 'form10-kt.htm', which no ticker-and-date pattern would match. planned_probes comes from the plan and probes_resolved from observations, so their equality is a real completeness check.
